name: CARBON Core Local AI Testing
free_limit: Free MIT-licensed local QA plugin and MCP runtime for risk-based testing, accessibility checks, regression planning, and HTML/JSON evidence reports; no CARBON account or paid feature unlock required.
watch_out: Requires a compatible coding agent and Node.js 22+; the host model subscription/API may incur charges or usage limits. Optional integrations and CARBON Pro are separate. Local execution can send context to the configured model provider; command analytics vary by edition.
